title: Tanker fire in Strait of Hormuz as Kuwaiti VLCC reported hit
excerpt: UKMTO confirmed a tanker caught fire after an attack in the Strait of Hormuz, while Vanguard Tech reported a Kuwaiti VLCC hit, the second in four days.
